Definition: properly, a repetition, i.e. a duplicate (copy of a document), or a double (in amount); by implication, a second (in order, rank, age, quality or location)
BiblicalUsage: 1) double, copy, second, repetition; 1a) double; 1b) copy (of law); 1c) second (in order); 1c1) second rank; 1c2) second in age; 1d) second quarter or district
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
